Authors: Christian Lanegger, Helen Oleynikova, Roland Siegwart, Michael Pantic

PBD-AG: Persistent Baseline-Delta Active Graphs with Uncertainty-Aware Inspection for Long-Horizon Service Robots Other

persistent world model active graph uncertainty-aware inspection long-horizon service robot hierarchical object belief

简要说明：PBD-AG 提出了一种面向长时服务机器人的持久化世界模型框架，将稳定固定物体与动态物体解耦，通过不确定性感知检查和图驱动的视点选择来维护可靠的分层物体信念。

TLDR: PBD-AG introduces a persistent world model framework for long-horizon service robots that decouples stable fixtures from dynamic objects, using uncertainty-aware inspection and graph-conditioned viewpoint selection to maintain reliable hierarchical object beliefs.

Abstract: Long-horizon service robots require persistent world models that can be built autonomously in unseen environments and revised as task-relevant objects change. Existing methods rely on online mapping, which accumulates localization and observation errors, static scene representations that cannot capture persistent object changes, or holistic vision-language predictions that lack verifiable 3D geometric evidence. We present PBD-AG, a persistent baseline-delta active graph framework that decouples robot-verified stable fixtures from revisable dynamic object events. Under our framework, the robot autonomously bootstraps the structural baseline from onboard exploration and inspects discovered fixtures to ground hierarchical object beliefs. PBD-AG maintains reliability-weighted object states over geometry, semantics, identity, existence, and support relations, utilizing a geometric visibility gate to mitigate false deletions under occlusion. Inspection viewpoints are selected by a graph-conditioned policy that balances target coverage, travel cost, collision risk, and redundant observation. Simulation experiments in multiple environments and under controlled dynamic evaluation show higher aggregate coarse-fixture F1 than capability-matched controls, as well as stronger identity continuity and event recall. A qualitative physical-robot demonstration further illustrates integration with onboard sensing, providing a traceable world model for long-horizon robotic perception. The project page of PBD-AG is available at https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/

摘要（中文）：长时域服务机器人需要持久的世界模型，该模型能在未知环境中自主构建，并在任务相关物体发生变化时进行修正。现有方法依赖于在线建图，但这会累积定位与观测误差；或采用静态场景表征，无法捕捉物体的持续变化；抑或依赖整体性的视觉-语言预测，缺乏可验证的3D几何证据。本文提出PBD-AG，一种持久化基线-动态主动图框架，将经机器人验证的稳定固定件与可修正的动态物体事件解耦。在该框架下，机器人通过机载探索自主引导结构基线的生成，并对已发现的固定件进行检验，以建立层级化的物体置信度。PBD-AG在几何、语义、身份、存在及支撑关系上维护基于可靠性权重的物体状态，并利用几何可见性门控机制来减少遮挡导致的误删除。检测视点由一种图条件策略选取，该策略平衡目标覆盖、移动成本、碰撞风险与冗余观测。多环境及受控动态评估下的仿真实验表明，本方法在聚合粗粒度固定件F1值上优于能力匹配的对照组，并具备更强的身份连续性与事件回忆能力。定性实物机器人演示进一步验证了其与机载感知的集成，为长时域机器人感知提供了可追溯的世界模型。PBD-AG项目页面见：https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/

Authors: Shuo Bao, Wei Dong, Shuyue Zhang, Ming Shang, Yuchen Huang, Han Yu, Chengjie Xu, Yiheng Bi, Kai Sun, Fuchun Sun, Xinzhou Wang

A Neural Network Based Teleoperation for Remote Controlled Vehicles AutonomousDriving

unilateral teleoperation wave variable approach RBFN vehicle edge computing hardware-in-the-loop

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于远程操控车辆的遥操作框架，结合波变量无源控制与自适应径向基函数网络，以应对通信延迟和未建模动力学问题。

TLDR: This paper proposes a teleoperation framework for remote-controlled vehicles that integrates Wave Variable passivity control with an adaptive Radial Basis Function Network to handle communication latency and unmodeled dynamics.

Abstract: Direct teleoperation of vehicles faces critical technical bottlenecks: communication latency and the operator's inability to physically perceive unmodeled environmental disturbances (e.g., aerodynamic drag, bank angles) coupled with highly nonlinear tire-road dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose a tailored unilateral teleoperation framework. The system integrates the Wave Variable (WV) approach to passively guarantee stability under stochastic delays, and an adaptive Radial Basis Function Network (RBFN) to actively compensate for vehicle-specific uncertainties. Unlike existing WV-neural network architectures designed for bilateral robotic arms, our framework features decoupled adaptive laws specifically designed for vehicle longitudinal and lateral dynamics. Furthermore, compared to model-heavy predictive controllers, the model-free RBFN offers rapid online adaptation without heavy computational overhead. Building upon our preliminary theoretical formulation, this brief paper presents comprehensive comparative analyses and real-world hardware validations. Simulation benchmarks against PID, LQR, MPC, and NMPC demonstrate that the RBFN achieves superior robustness against unmodeled disturbances while requiring orders of magnitude less execution time than MPC and NMPC, making it ideal for resource-constrained vehicle edge computing. Finally, hardware-in-the-loop experiments using a 1/10th scale vehicle over a 4G network validate the system's practical feasibility, safety, and robust trajectory tracking under physical road uncertainties.

摘要（中文）：车辆直接遥操作面临关键技术瓶颈：通信时延以及操作员无法物理感知未建模环境扰动（如空气阻力、侧倾角）与强非线性轮胎-路面动力学的耦合作用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种定制化的单向遥操作框架。该系统集成波变量（WV）方法以在随机时延下被动保证稳定性，并采用自适应径向基函数网络（RBFN）主动补偿车辆特异性不确定性。与现有面向双臂机器人的WV-神经网络架构不同，本框架具有专为车辆纵向与横向动力学解耦设计的自适应律。此外，相较于依赖大量模型的预测控制器，无模型RBFN无需繁重计算开销即可实现快速在线自适应。基于前期理论公式，本文通过综合性对比分析与实际硬件验证，揭示了：在PID、LQR、MPC及NMPC的仿真基准测试中，RBFN对未建模扰动展现出更优鲁棒性，且执行时间较MPC与NMPC降低数个数量级，使其成为资源受限车辆边缘计算的理想方案。最终，基于1/10比例车辆在4G网络下的硬件在环实验，验证了该系统在真实道路不确定性下的实际可行性、安全性及鲁棒轨迹跟踪性能。

Authors: Ning Ding, Azim Eskandarian

Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models Other

spatial reasoning knowledge distillation vision-language models geometry grounding 3D scene understanding

简要说明：本文提出多视角关系蒸馏（MVRD），通过从几何基础模型转移几何对应关系来改进VLM的空间推理能力，同时保持视觉语言对齐，有益于具身AI和自动驾驶任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes multi-view relational distillation (MVRD) to improve spatial reasoning in VLMs by transferring geometric correspondences from geometry-grounded models without disrupting vision-language alignment, benefiting embodied AI and autonomous driving tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size at inference. Knowledge distillation from geometry-grounded vision models offers an alternative, but directly matching multi-view teacher features can disrupt the pretrained alignment between visual and textual representations, degrading object- and language-semantic capabilities. We propose multi-view relational distillation (MVRD), which distills patch-wise cosine similarities across views instead of the teacher features themselves. These relations encode geometric correspondences adequate for spatial understanding, while leaving the student representation underdetermined, allowing it to remain close to its pretrained vision- language space. Across representative VLMs, MVRD improves visual-spatial reasoning, outperforming supervised fine-tuning and feature distillation while approaching feature fusion methods with considerably fewer added parameters and lower latency. We show that MVRD makes visual representations more geometric while retaining language alignment, and generalizes to 3D scene understanding tasks such as object grounding, dense captioning, and question answering.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLM）在图像与视频理解方面已取得显著成效，但其视觉空间表征在几何结构上仍存在脆弱性，导致在具身智能、机器人及自动驾驶所需的空间推理任务中表现不佳。现有的几何表征方法要么通过在空间问答任务上微调VLM（这可能导致虚假视觉表征的持续存在），要么融合来自大规模几何感知视觉模型的特征（这会显著增加推理时的模型规模）。从几何感知视觉模型进行知识蒸馏虽提供另一种思路，但直接匹配多视角教师特征可能破坏视觉与文本表征之间预训练的对齐关系，从而削弱物体识别与语言语义能力。本文提出多视角关系蒸馏（MVRD）方法，该方法在不同视角间蒸馏块级余弦相似度而非教师特征本身。这些关系编码了足以支撑空间理解的几何对应信息，同时使学生表征保持欠定状态，从而使其能维持接近预训练的视觉-语言空间。在代表性VLM上的实验表明，MVRD能提升视觉空间推理能力，其性能优于监督微调和特征蒸馏方法，同时以显著更少的参数量和更低延迟接近特征融合方法。我们证实MVRD在保持语言对齐的同时使视觉表征更具几何特性，并能泛化至三维场景理解任务，包括目标定位、密集描述和问答。
